resources.string: Fixes wired headset controls in Apple Music not skipping to the previous track

If it shows inactive, check: enable this module in LSPosed, select Apple Music in its scope (the default scope is built in), connect a wired headset the system recognizes, then force stop and reopen Apple Music
With a wired headset connected, tap Force stop, reopen Apple Music, then press the headset button three times to skip to the previous track
Only tested on Apple Music 7.0.0. Other versions are untested. Bluetooth headsets are not affected by this module

This module fixes the issue where the device cannot use a wired headset to skip to the previous track. Connect a wired headset, tap Force stop, then open Apple Music and use the headset to skip to the previous track normally
